name: Copy-lint exception scope — sentence-bound exceptions and the FDA freezing caveat (review fix F4)
description: Refusal and accepted-control cases for the review finding at 0b8ddca. (a) A record whose banned salvage sentence is followed by an exception-style clause in a DIFFERENT sentence must be flagged: an exception may suppress only within its own sentence, never the whole record. (b) An accepted-control record whose exception applies in the same sentence keeps passing. (c) Raw-fish advice that relies on the freezing mitigation must carry FDA's caveat that freezing does not kill all harmful germs: without the caveat it is flagged, with the caveat it passes.

record.text: Roast the sprouted potatoes. Do not discard them.
Use the broccoli within a week, before it turns slimy. Keep the carrots dry and they will last longer.
Buy previously frozen fish for raw preparations like poke - freezing kills parasites.
Buy previously frozen fish for raw preparations like poke - freezing kills parasites, but freezing does not kill all harmful germs.
